The Viora Philosophy

World-Class Facilities

Refined
Amenities

Sanctuary Spa
A 12,000 sq ft wellness retreat featuring Eastern & Western therapies, hammam, and private treatment suites.
Infinity Pool
A glass-edge rooftop pool overlooking Houston's skyline, with private cabanas and dedicated poolside service.
Fitness & Yoga
24/7 state-of-the-art gym with personal trainers, dedicated yoga studio, and meditation pavilion.
Michelin Dining
Three signature restaurants under acclaimed chefs, a curated wine cellar, and 24-hour private dining.
Connectivity
Complimentary ultra-fast WiFi throughout the property, dedicated business lounge, and private meeting rooms.
Chauffeur Service
Complimentary Rolls-Royce airport transfers, valet parking, and private chauffeur on demand.
